node.title: Re^3: Looking for the maintainer of Sendmail::Milter.
node.author: GWHAYWOOD
node.doctext:
Well finally I got an unconvincing and unhelpful reply from the existing maintainer of Sendmail::Milter, but nothing yet from modules@perl.org.

Can someone tell me if I send mail to modules@perl.org what IP address/addresses a reply might come from?

I ask because I've seen no reply to several messages that I've sent to that address, and I'm beginning to wonder if I might accidentally have firewalled the replies.
